title: Moocow
html_source:
Definition: a child’s name for a cow.

By using this babytalk word in this first sentence, Joyce establishes the narrator as employing a childish diction and idiom.

Awww look at the cute moocow!

We’ll see the narrator’s language, grammatical complexity, and intelligence increase with Stephen as he grows up and develops intellectually.
